data.name: RuneKeeper
data.detailed_description:
Before the first sunrise, five gods walked the void hand in hand.

They were siblings born from the same thought:

Alaz the Smith, Skadi the Endurer, Litavis the Grower, Shezmu the Dreamer, and Prometheus the Beating Heart.

Together they forged the world's mountains hammered on Alaz’s anvil, seas frozen by Skadi’s sigh, forests sung from Litavis's seed, deserts spun from Shezmu's laughter, and every living pulse tied to Prometheus's drum.

Then came the betrayal...

RuneKeeper is an open-world monster taming RPG, heavily inspired by old-school Western RPGs

You will be able to interact and move almost everything in the world whether good or bad, but be warned, your actions will have consequences.

Features

  • Highly interactive world

  • Player Freedom

  • Monster Taming

  • Classless talent system

  • Deep Character Customization

  • Single or Multiplayer

data.short_description: RuneKeeper is an Open-World Sandbox RPG with monster taming elements where you can choose to follow the story, or just simply live in the world with your friends in the world of Rin. It's up to you!
